notices.short_title: Childcare Center Tax Abatement Rule
notices.plain: The Department of Finance will hold a public hearing on Feb. 20, 2026, on a proposed rule about tax abatements for childcare centers.

notices.short_title: 1605-CRB(R) MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR OF CARBON ODOR CONTROL SYSTEM AT VARIOUS WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANTS, PUMPS STATIONS AND ASSOCIATED DEP FACILITIES

notices.short_title: East Brooklyn Industrial Business Solutions Provider Services in Brooklyn

notices.plain: City University is seeking bids for exterminating and pest control services across its colleges, with responses due Feb. 17, 2026, in a correction to an earlier notice.

notices.short_title: PRE-SOLICITATION CONFERENCE - BID # 2600041 BEACH CLEANER - RAKE TYPE - PARKS

notices.short_title: PRE-SOLICITATION MEETING - BID # 2600042 TUB GRINDER - PARKS
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for a tub grinder for the Parks Department, with responses due Feb. 10, 2026, and a pre-solicitation meeting held beforehand.

notices.short_title: Correction: ON-CALL REFRIGERATION FOR DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTION FACILITIES, ALL BOROUGHS

notices.short_title: 05726Y0568-057260000527 Air Chisel/Hammer Rescue Kit

notices.short_title: Reproductive Health - Educational Instruction

notices.short_title: Costar Subscription

notices.short_title: 05626Y0223-MMPI-3 Examination Kits
